item.title: [amitseg] Gilad Erdan, chairman of the Unity Party:
item.description:

Gilad Erdan, chairman of the Unity Party:

“Throughout my life, I have served the people of Israel and the State of Israel. It was out of this sense of mission that, several weeks ago, I founded the ‘Unity’ Party, because I believe Israel needs a broad Zionist government capable of passing a genuine military conscription law and resolving disputes.

I believed that the horrific massacre of October 7 and the terrible price paid by Israel’s citizens require us to change course.

Unfortunately, after about a month of campaigning, the reality is that in the upcoming elections, a large majority of the public is seeking, above all, a clear decision on the question of who will serve as prime minister, while the need for a broad unity government does not rank high among voters’ priorities.

Despite the extensive efforts we have made, support thus far for the ‘Unity’ Party that I founded does not provide a high likelihood of crossing the electoral threshold, and efforts to join forces with other parties in the unity bloc have also failed to materialize.

I have therefore decided that the ‘Unity’ Party will not run in the upcoming elections.

Leadership also means recognizing reality as it is and acting responsibly. I believe we must ensure that our voters’ ballots influence the outcome of the election rather than go to waste.

I thank everyone who believed in the path of unity, volunteered, supported, and helped, and especially my colleagues in the party leadership — Yuli Edelstein, Aliza Bloch, Oren Smadja, and Hezi Nehama — for their partnership, their work, and their belief in our path. It was an honor to lead this wonderful group: exceptional people who believe in the idea and importance of unity and who will continue to fight for it wherever they may be.

Today, I am withdrawing the ‘Unity’ Party’s candidacy, but not my commitment to public service or my path as a public servant. I will continue to do everything I can for the people, for the soldiers of the IDF, and for a better future in Israel.”

מדובר בהפרה בוטה של ארגון הטרור חיזבאללה.

צה"ל תוקף כעת בתגובה בדרום לבנון.

כוחות צה"ל ימשיכו לפעול במרחב הביטחוני להסרת כל איום על אזרחי מדינת ישראל וכוחות צה"ל.

צה"ל פועל כעת ויפעל גם בהמשך בעוצמה מול ניסיונותיו החוזרים ונשנים של ארגון הטרור חיזבאללה לפגוע בכוחותינו.
